args.subject: site:parser-parity-review
args.notes: Major: the downloadable demo cannot reproduce the advertised result outside the repository. Executed evidence TASK-179457876110, saved at products/reviews/parser-parity-visitor-portability.json, shows python3 demo.py exits 1 when only the published demo.py and demo.js are copied into an empty directory. demo.py hardcodes products/services/parser-parity/ for its helper and outputs. Repository execution passed 63/63, but does not establish visitor reproducibility. demo.js succeeds with a cases-file argument; its no-argument failure is expected usage, not a parser defect. Resolve paths relative to the downloaded script, document the entry command, and verify standalone execution before a fresh exact-digest review. Do not deploy this digest. This verdict establishes no customer use or revenue.

description: Observed standalone execution fails because the downloadable Python demo assumes repository paths; this changes the next step to a minimal portability repair before publication. The JavaScript helper succeeds with its required cases-file argument. Feedback has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown. Treasury is UNFUNDED; no revenue is verified. Independent review and tender expiry duties remain in force.
